title: Phase 6 — cut over and remove the shims
description: Release both. Document the install path for someone who wants a factory. Delete the Phase 1 shims. Answer the last open question: does 'cloud' survive as a substrate NAME in .tick/runners.toml once the implementation lives elsewhere? The vocabulary argument says yes — runners.toml already resolves cloud as a peer of harness and herdr, and ticks knows about herdr the same way today without owning it. Also decide what happens to the skills: skills/ticks/references/{agent-runner,runners-config,tk-commands}.md all describe factory and cloud surfaces, and need splitting between the ticks skill and a new factory skill.
notes: 2026-09-02 13:34 - Closed 2026-09-02 as legacy (Peter: no cycles on the old world). Superseded by project hzm (ticfac). The decoupling this project did stands and is built on by hzm Phase 1/2; the remaining move and cutover are hzm Phases 1, 4 and 7.
acceptance_criteria: Both repos released and installable independently. A new user can deploy a factory following documentation that does not assume a ticks checkout. No Phase 1 shim remains. The runners.toml substrate-name decision and the skills split are both recorded.
